scheme_name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for Textile Sector: Assistance Of Interest Subsidy For Textile Sector
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Must be a new manufacturing/service unit or an existing unit undertaking expansion/diversification in the MSME sector
Unit must have commenced commercial production between 20.05.2022 and 19.05.2027
Enterprise must apply on the online portal within one year from the date of eligibility
Unit must be located in the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
benefits_summary: Up to 60% interest subsidy up to ₹60 lakh per year for five years (or loan tenure), with an additional 10% subsidy for export‑oriented carpet industry up to ₹70 lakh per year.
